title: The 10 Best MIG Welders
subtitle: Flux-core and gas MIG welders for home garages, farms and fabrication, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: A MIG welder feeds wire through a gun to join steel quickly, the easiest kind of welding to learn. We ranked 10 best-sellers from YESWELDER, ARCCAPTAIN, Lincoln Electric, BESTMIG and FEMEROL on rating, review volume and features (gas MIG capability, 110V/220V input, spool-gun aluminum and synergic setup). Flux-core-only machines are the cheapest way to start.

changelog.note: Page published with 10 ranked picks and 1 tool to avoid.

avoid.name: 145A MIG Welder, 110V 3-in-1 Flux Core Stick Lift TIG, 7.5 lb
avoid.flag: Says 'no extra purchases required'; TIG torch sold separately
avoid.verdict: A flux-core welder sold as a 3-in-1 'MIG' welder whose listing contradicts itself on what's in the box and offers only a 30-day money-back guarantee.
reasons: It promises 'Everything you need is in one box... no extra purchases required', but the first bullet says 'TIG torch not included—please purchase separately', so one of its three advertised modes needs another purchase.
It's called a MIG welder but only runs gasless flux-core wire; there's no gas MIG option.
The 'Warranty & Service' section offers 24-hour support and a 30-day money-back guarantee but states no warranty period at all. Lincoln, for comparison, lists 12 months on its 90i FC.

buyers_guide.a: Flux-core wire makes its own shielding, so there's no gas bottle and it works outdoors in wind; welds are spattery and need cleanup. Gas MIG uses solid wire and a CO2/argon bottle for clean welds on thinner metal, best indoors. Many welders here do both.
110V machines plug into a garage outlet and handle sheet metal up to about 3/16 inch. 220V roughly doubles the usable power for thicker steel. Dual-voltage welders give you both.
Usually only with a spool gun (sold separately) and argon gas. Welders marked spool-gun ready, like the ARCCAPTAIN MIG200/MIG250 and YESWELDER MIG-205DS, can do it.
You pick the wire size or metal thickness and the welder sets matching voltage and wire speed. It makes learning much easier; experienced welders can switch to manual.
An auto-darkening helmet, leather gloves and jacket, a wire brush and grinder, clamps, and for gas MIG a bottle of shielding gas. Weld in a ventilated area and keep a fire extinguisher close.
